description: The L2 band: GPS L2C at 1227.6 MHz with CNAV from the native RINEX 4 records (L5 bit set, L2 bit clear; type 0 where a record lacks the flag word), and GLONASS G2 at 1246 MHz + k x 0.4375 MHz, in one 25 MHz IQ4 stream centred on 1238 MHz; static receiver, 5 s.
name: l2_band_gps_l2c_glonass_g2
